gloss: to thin out (plants); to cull; to reduce

definitions.explanation: to remove some seedlings or plants to allow the remaining ones to grow better

definitions.gloss: to reduce; to cut back (services, frequency)
definitions.explanation: to decrease the frequency or number of something

examples.japanese: {密集|みっしゅう}している{部分|ぶぶん}を{間引|まび}く。
{大根|だいこん}の{芽|め}を{間引|まび}いて{育|そだ}てる。
examples.english: Grow daikon by thinning out the sprouts.

examples.japanese: バスの{本数|ほんすう}を{間引|まび}いた。
examples.english: They reduced the number of bus services.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}が{間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}になった。
examples.english: The trains switched to reduced service.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{便|びん}を{間引|まび}いた。
examples.english: Flights were reduced due to the typhoon.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

USAGE:
- {苗|なえ}を{間引|まび}く (to thin seedlings)
- {運行|うんこう}を{間引|まび}く (to reduce service frequency)
- {間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん} (reduced service operation)

GARDENING:
Thinning allows remaining plants to receive more sunlight, water, and nutrients. The removed seedlings ({間引|まび}き{菜|な}) are often edible.

RELATED:
- {剪定|せんてい} (pruning)
- {摘|つ}む (to pick, pluck)
- {減便|げんびん} (reduction in services)
